items.title: Is Kroger (KR) Undervalued Or Is Its Cash Flow Already Priced In?
items.summary: Kroger has delivered strong long term share gains, yet the real question for investors today is whether the current price is fully backed by the cash the business is expected to generate over time. The stock has returned 76.9% over 5 years, which puts real pressure on the cash flow story to justify where the valuation sits now. Fresh scrutiny of lead levels in baby food products sold through Harris Teeter and Kroger branded snacks may affect how investors think about future compliance costs,...
